notes.title: First Post! Update 1.3 is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43608134/8a70bd66066366d201da178362d6190c9010c1cc.png

To demonstrate our active development, we plan to increase the frequency of our announcements. As a one-person team, my focus remains on development, and the community comes after. At this time, I prefer to concentrate on development rather than marketing. With each new feature and bug fix, I am confident that our sales numbers will increase, allowing us to expand the team. We value patience and appreciate your support.

We're excited to announce that Defending Earth's upcoming update 1.3 will include numerous new features, graphical changes, and bug fixes, providing a fantastic experience for players. We appreciate your patience and assure you that Defending Earth will not disappoint you.

We apologize for the delay in announcing the sale, which will take place after the Spring Break Sale on Steam due to the proximity of the release date. (Secret: March 30, 2023)
